What if you ate peanut butter every single day?
It's one of the most loved spreads in America. Two tablespoons give you about seven grams of protein and healthy fats that keep you full. Peanuts also have fiber, magnesium and vitamin E.

But here's the twist. Those same two tablespoons have nearly two hundred calories, and many brands add sugar, salt and oils. Experts say pick a jar with just peanuts and a little salt, and stir the oil back in. And it's easy to eat way more than two tablespoons straight from the jar!
